# FormulaTransformer

<link-summary>Rewrites one formula.</link-summary>

<web-summary>FormulaTransformer — Rewrites one formula. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
type FormulaTransformer = (formula: string, row: number, column: number) => string;
```

It receives the formula and the row and column it sits in, and returns the formula to put back. Returning the one it was given leaves the cell untouched, and `updateFormulas` writes only the cells that actually changed.

## Examples

### Shape

```javascript
const rewrite = (formula, row, column) => formula.replace("Sheet1", "Data");
```
